notes.title: Ecoplanet Gameplay Livestream
notes.notes:
My name is Brad McDavitt, I am the sole developer of Ecoplanet which is an ecosystem-building tycoon game. If you are a fan of games like Roller Coaster Tycoon and Viva Pinata you will enjoy Ecoplanet. You are in charge of running an island tour business and you will have to make unique stunning islands if you want to become successful. If you don't like the tycoon side then there will also be lots of other opportunities to make money to unlock cool animals and plants to improve your island!

I will showing off the majority of the features of Ecoplanet and releasing a small demo that will be running throughout the steam event. This demo will have a lot of features cut-out to give you something to look forward to on release. However, I will be streaming the game fully unlocked so you can get a good understanding of all that Ecoplanet has to offer!
